body: CHECK MAINLINE-019, the first of two on this order (020 follows): the arithmetic reproduces. My own scripts (owner scripts not run) match 158 items to at most 2.6e-8, with 0 mismatches; the 34 source pins still match. Line items: optimistic 535.95 kg (10.96%) and conservative 4229.07 kg (86.49%), set by aluminium, every item reproduced (systems excess 0/1366.33, joints and films 124.65/939.69, water 125.66/1256.64, contamination 5/25, temperature and pressure 213.04/485.76, humidity 18.70/106.76, internal air 48.89; aramid 529.92/4205.89). Climate formula: the ideal-mixture moist-air density ratio referenced to dry ISA, split exactly into dry and humid parts; +25.1 K alone is 395.89 kg. Both families reproduce on each line at 0, 5, 10.96 and 86.49%: aramid 0.685398/0.650413/0.608701/0.009665 and aluminium 0.668711/0.617051/0.556669/0.012716. So do the panel widths, vacuum route, sensitivities and the 290 GPa row. Not reproduced: 014b's grid value, whose grid is unstated. Text: the order quotes the id as rpt-lead-sciences-…, but it is filed as rpt-lead-sci-…; and payload is 0 kg on both lines, though the brief asks for a conservative value. Objection, demonstrated with 018's own curves: the step rule gives aramid the optimistic gamma 1 and aluminium the conservative 0.2. Either curve applied to both puts aluminium ahead: optimistic curve 0.847 against 0.609 on the optimistic line (0.988 against 0.685 at margin 0, capped by Be face compression); conservative curve 0.557 against 0.253. Every value is QUESTIONABLE; nothing here is a certification.
